summary: Opened a fourth, independent client-contract question and submitted its execution: VerifyLeader sizes its quorum from voters but registers the verification on every replication stream, including non-voters. The harness demotes two of five members, cuts the leader from both other voters, and compares leaving the non-voters reachable against cutting them too; native feedback showed the trigger returning success while only one of three voters was reachable, so the retained receipt will decide whether non-voter acknowledgements substitute for voter support.
